title: Generated surfaces
current: CI repo contracts check generated inline blocks, manifest-backed wake claims and rendered Claude, Codex and Cursor agent surfaces against their canonical sources. Run the renderer named by each failure, commit its outputs and rerun verification; the installed pre-commit hook does not perform render checks. Render relationship registration reads existing path-context values once and batch-writes changed values; unchanged rows retain their timestamps and provenance. In a Yoke source checkout the native harness views (.claude/agents, .claude/rules, .claude/skills/yoke, .codex/hooks.json, .codex/agents, .cursor/agents) are gitignored; yoke dev setup, lane preparation and the pull, merge, checkout and rebase git hooks recreate missing or stale ones, and HC-harness-substrate-drift names any that are missing with yoke agents render as the fix.
